subject: integration
name: Payment facilitator standard (FACILITATOR_0_1)
summary: Defines the calls the browser's own payments make to an installed facilitator: quote legs between two assets, prepare one after the person has paid, and follow it; a site's ask is answered like an unknown code. The browser bounds every answer against the quote and its own node, and counts a leg done only when that node shows the quoted amount reach the destination. Who holds the funds and who can stop them is the facilitator's own statement; nothing here checks it. The row runs nothing and connects to nothing. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
